Some IPTV providers gate playlist or stream access by the request\'s User-Agent. Pick a known-good preset, or paste a custom string.
Applied to every outgoing HTTP request from YancoTV. Switching is instant for new connections.

Export sources, favorites, history, recordings, and settings to a single JSON file. Restore on this device or another. Credentials are saved in plaintext unless you enable password encryption.
Source credentials will be re-encrypted under your password (PBKDF2 + AES/GCM). You\'ll need this password to restore.
Source credentials will be in PLAINTEXT in the file. Don\'t share or upload this file.

Existing sources, favorites, and history are NOT deleted. New rows are added; conflicting source rows are skipped (your local credentials win). After restore, your sources will resync — favorites and history may take a moment to relink.
No backups in your Downloads/YancoTV folder. Use Export above to make your first one.
Use → load this backup as the restore source. Delete → remove the metadata row (the file on disk is left untouched).

An IPTV client for Android TV, Fire TV, and phones. Bring your Xtream login, M3U URL, M3U file, or Stalker portal — YancoTV handles the EPG and recordings, remembers where you left off in every movie and series, and ships voice search, parental controls, and cast-to-TV.
What leaves your device, and how to opt out. Full policy linked below.
If something crashes, send a stack trace + device model + OS version to our error tracker so we can fix it. No content, no playlist URLs, no credentials. Off = nothing leaves the device.
This build does not have an update endpoint configured.
Contacting the YancoTV release feed now.
To change your PIN, confirm the current one first.
Removing the PIN will disable parental controls.
Current PIN OK — enter the new one.
No channels are hidden. Long-press a channel in LiveTV / Movies / Series to hide it.
Add a source first — Settings → Sources.
REFRESH pulls a fresh EPG payload. RE-SYNC re-walks every active source so a rotated EPG URL is auto-adopted.
No active source with a URL configured.
Per-event toggles for EPG reminders, source-sync completion, recording-ready alerts, and update prompts. Routes through WorkManager — unblocked once MK.14 adds the DVR event producer.
Image cache size, EPG cache size, SQLite DB footprint, and one-tap clear actions. Waiting on a size-aggregator in the shared cache layer so the read is cheap enough to refresh on tab entry.

Default caption language, text size, color, background opacity and vertical position. You can already adjust subtitles for the current video from the player — the defaults that persist across restarts will live here.
Quick reference for the TV-remote and keyboard bindings YancoTV listens for. Shortcuts aren\'t user-configurable yet — let us know in the issues if any clash with your remote.

Open the Recordings tab in the sidebar to play, delete, and inspect any recording you\'ve made. New recordings show up there immediately as they start.

Stock Fire TV\'s folder picker has known D-pad bugs (the Select / hamburger / tab buttons can be unreachable from the remote). It\'s a Fire OS limitation, not a YancoTV bug. Fix: install Files by Google — Fire TV will route the picker through it. Or switch to Public folder above; recordings save without ever using the system picker.
Saving took too long. Restart the app and try again — if it keeps happening, the credential store may need to be reset.
